name: add_domain_unsubscribes
description: Add addresses to a marketing domain's unsubscribe list so that domain stops sending to them.

name: add_image
description: Add an image to the brand library from a public URL, a batch of URLs, or an uploaded file.

name: audit_email
description: Audit an email before a production send and return precise findings (costs credits for a complete audit).

name: cancel_automation_run
description: Cancel one running event or test run of an automation.

description: Check whether a trigger can fire now and which published automations consume it. Nothing fires or changes.

name: clone_email
description: Copy an email design exactly, without AI.

name: create_email

description: Start uploading a local image file to the brand library.

name: create_inbox_placement_test
description: Start a seed test for inbox and spam placement from a verified domain.

name: delete_audience

name: delete_automation
description: Permanently delete an automation. Already delivered emails stay delivered.

name: delete_brand_image
description: Delete one image from the brand library.

name: delete_contact_field
description: Remove a custom contact field and its value from every contact.

name: delete_contacts
description: Permanently delete one or more contacts by email. Asks for confirmation first.

name: delete_domain
description: Remove a sending domain.

name: delete_email
description: Permanently delete an email design and all its versions.

name: delete_email_group

name: delete_trigger
description: Remove an unused automation trigger.

name: edit_email

description: Export a design as a template to an email provider already connected in Brew.

name: get_brand
description: Read the brand's design system, voice, and logos.

name: get_brand_status
description: Poll brand extraction until the brand is ready for design work.

name: get_brew_capabilities

name: get_chat_artifacts
description: Read the email designs, automations, and triggers a selected Brew chat references.

name: get_domain_health
description: Diagnose sending-domain DNS, authentication, reputation, and deliverability.

name: get_email
description: Show an existing email design with its preview, versions, or generation status.

name: get_email_analytics
description: Read overview, per-send, and per-recipient engagement analytics.

name: get_email_audit
description: Read a saved email audit and its findings without running a new one.

name: get_email_rendering
description: Read a saved inbox-rendering job with per-client screenshot links.

name: get_flow
description: Show one public email sequence by slug, with its steps.

name: get_inbox_placement_results
description: Read the results of an inbox placement test.

name: get_insight

name: get_template
description: View one public template, including a reference email id for create_email.

name: get_usage
description: Check plan, remaining credits, and send allowance for the organization.

name: import_domain_unsubscribes

name: infer_payload_contract

name: list_automation_runs
description: Inspect automation executions and manual-audience launches.

name: list_automations
description: List saved automations with their publication state and optional analytics.

name: list_brands
description: List the brands this connection can access.

name: list_chats

name: list_contact_fields
description: List the brand's contact field definitions and types.

name: list_domains

name: list_email_comments

name: list_email_groups
description: List email folders with their ids.

name: list_emails
description: List the brand's saved email designs by folder or status.

name: list_flows
description: Browse public brand email sequences by brand, category, or relevance.

name: list_insights
description: List the brand's Brew Insights, most severe first.

name: list_integrations
description: List connected and available integrations.

name: list_notifications
description: List the brand's Brew notifications, newest first.

name: list_trigger_events
description: Read past trigger fires, their match state, and the runs they started.

name: list_triggers
description: List automation trigger definitions, or read one with its integration brief.
